$comment: Authored (WP-F). The exact provisional set (D-002). `tokens:check` fails when the emitted provisional tokens differ from categories + names + the pipeline-defined extras, so adding or removing one is a reviewed change. `nonTokens` are D-002 items that have no custom property; they are listed in the docs' 'Differences and open items' page.

categories.reason: Data-viz colours: Tecton documents none. Proposed from the accent fill stops (categorical) and the onLight ramp (sequential); the teal/brown/indigo slots borrow lime/yellow/orchid (docs/research/tecton-theme.md 3.8).
Motion: Tecton has no source; the upstream Astryx durations and easing are kept.

names.name: --size-element-lg
names.reason: Control height 36px has no Tecton source (Tecton names only sm 28 and md 32); the upstream value is kept.

nonTokens.name: breakpoints
nonTokens.reason: sm 640, md 768, lg 1024, xl 1280, 2xl 1536: upstream DEFAULT_WIDTH_BREAKPOINTS, no Tecton source. Exported from tokens.js / tokens.json (not custom properties: they cannot be used in media queries).

nonTokens.name: z-index
nonTokens.reason: Astryx defines no z-index tokens; overlays use the top layer. Nothing to map.

nonTokens.name: letter-spacing
nonTokens.reason: Tecton has no letter-spacing anywhere; components use `normal`. Astryx has no tracking tokens either.

nonTokens.name: destructive button
nonTokens.reason: No Tecton source; painted from the --tecton-color-status-error-filled-* roles (component work packages).

nonTokens.name: icons: chevronsLeft, chevronsRight, calendar, clock, checkDouble, stop
nonTokens.reason: Six roles without a Tecton glyph; covered by the Lucide default set (D-009).
